firmware_states.description: Battery-only deep off (BQ25792 ship mode or SW101 open). 3V_AO dead unless VBUS present; MCU unpowered. Wake: QON held 1 s or VBUS plug.
User-visible off; the only off state with VBUS present. All switched rails off, MCU in Stop, wake on SW100, encoder push, AUX plug or PD events.
5V_LOGIC, 3V3_AUDIO and Bluetooth up, amplifiers off; 5V_CODEC on only if USB is granted and a candidate.
Boost and both amplifiers on, PCM1862 master; U6 BTL, U7 PBTL; sequence follows datasheet 9.5.3.1.
TPA6132A2 enabled; boost, amps and ADC off; analogue pass-through.
Flag valid in S1-S3 whenever VBUS is valid and granted; not a state of its own.
Latched sub-states F-AMP, F-CHG, F-PD, F-BATT, F-THERM; force amplifiers off.
Amps off 3 min after signal loss; S2->S1 after 20 min on battery or 60 min on external power; no standby-to-ship timer. All are proposals.
LOW1 20 % (ceiling -3 dB), LOW2 10 % (-6 dB), CRIT 5 % or VCELL < 3.30 V (stop amps, S1), ship at 3 % or VCELL < 3.20 V on battery. Proposals, tune to the real pack.

firmware_open.detail: The firmware spec is paper only; nothing was measured on hardware.
No LED, buzzer or display exists; an RGB LED on PB13-15 is proposed but is a hardware change needing owner approval.
No button ladder, USB_SRC_DET, CODEC_SSPND, HID volume, rail power-good, or amp mute pin. USB host detection uses a TPS25730 register heuristic (untested).
PBTL takes the left frame only; (L+R)/2 must come from a TAS5825M DSP mixer in PPC3, not verified (risk R1).
Owner to approve LR4 150 Hz and whether to use the PPC3 Smart Amp excursion flow (needs TI tooling access).
Owner to approve idle timers, SOC thresholds (20/10/5/3 %), AGL steps, and charge target (4.20 vs 4.10 V; 4.10 V now chosen).
SW100 tap play/pause, hold 1 s power, hold 5 s deep off; encoder push mute/source/pairing. All proposals needing owner decision.
Only four TPA6132A2 gain steps; USB host volume cannot be moved from the speaker.
AVRCP absolute volume, battery report and pairing UART commands are not in local files (unverified); baud and MFB polarity to confirm.
Register facts are from memory because the local PDF text is unreadable.
Nine new bench checks (ramp times, DC steps, HP_DET removal, TAS5825M PVDD scale, BM83 timing, QON idle level, etc.).

rules.v: Only 0/45/90 degree traces, every run as short as possible, routed in order of importance; no joint sharper than 90 degrees
F.Cu signals over In1 GND; B.Cu sensitive nets (I2S, USB, clocks, analog audio) only over In2 GND, GND via every 5-8 mm
Parallel signals at least 3x dielectric height (0.6 mm on 0.21 mm prepreg) over runs > 3 mm; I2S-to-I2S needs its own rule
New DRC rules placed after the neck_* relaxations and proven with a sentinel rule
Analog and digital loads on 3V3 get separate branches; pours or >= 0.4 mm tracks
ILIM/PROG/TS/FB pins at least 1.0 mm from SW or L nodes unless pin pitch forbids
Segment between 45 degree bends at least 3x trace width (min 0.4 mm on signals)
Reject slow nets > 100 mm without reason (30 nets exceeded it in R6q)
Length / octilinear minimum median <= 1.15 and p95 <= 1.4; clean DRC alone is not proof; run helpers/r7_metrics.py
1 oz outer 0.10/0.10 mm track/space, min via drill 0.15 mm (0.2-0.3 preferred), annular ring >= 0.15 mm

notes.v: Owner answers applied: hotplate is very large, so board size and plate uniformity were not researched.
All SMD is on the top side; plate contact must be flat, so no B.Cu parts or protruding solder.
Several sources were not reachable (Chemtools TDS, IPC-7525/7351 text, TAS5825M package addendum, BM83 pad drawing); evidence for hotplate profiles is thin.
Out-of-stock parts (U1, U2, U19) do not block hand assembly; the owner buys from any supplier and does not need JLC assembly stock.
U11 TPS25730D paste/mask openings were rebuilt as solid rectangles (R9) after the comb-shaped 0.1 mm openings were found.
